name: motif_query
description:
Query forms. Filters and groups forms, stems, uses or objects from available Trial evidence with and, or, not and typed field predicates, reads forms from the Baseline or a Proposal's Trial copy with parse state and analyses (--as-of, --sides both), runs a motif.query.v2 JSON document (--query-json) or prints its schema (--schema), or runs the saved query of a Parsimony Measure.
Command: query forms. Agent class: Read.

query.description: A motif.query.v2 document: version "motif.query.v2", from, where (and/or/not over {field, op, value} predicates; ops eq ne in nin lt gt has regex contains exists; regex is anchored, contains is not), side, sides, sort, limit, group and the options below. Replaces every other query argument. The full JSON Schema is returned by motif_query_schema and printed by motif query --schema. phon {"phon":"Stop V Stop V"} and env {"env":"[Stop] / # _ V"} match phonological patterns through PanGloss (syntax in motif_query_schema; class names from motif_query_schema values=classes); morph, seq and realizes are reserved and refused as not yet available.

saved.description: A measure id whose saved query replaces from, where and group.

from.description: Query source; required unless saved is given.

group.description: Columns to group by; required unless saved is given.

distinct.description: A column of which a group needs two different values.

fold.description: Fold set of the fold column: comma-separated nfc, case, iy~y, o~u, e~i, c~k, from>to or project; default nfc,case.

segment_test.description: How phon and env test a segment: engine (the default) is rule application's test, a literal matches every segment with its feature bundle and a [class] the union of its members' features, and the spans are a superset of what a rule rewrites; identity is exact members only. Every phon and env result reports the mode it used.

trial_id.description: Trial id; only the latest Trial has query rows.

dropped.description: Letters the stem edge has today.

gained.description: Letters the hypothesis puts there; may be empty.

affixes.description: Affixes the change fires before (final) or after (initial), without hyphens.

wordSets.description: Ids of attested sampled-tokens word sets that evidence looks forms up in.

discovery.description: Word sets the hypothesis was mined from.

heldOut.description: Held-out word sets; control returns counts only.

controlLetters.description: Control letters to use instead of the chosen ones.

score.description: Scorers run over the whole universe: tolerance, reliability, control (need change), split, size (stems or forms); no group.

exceptions.description: ANDed selectors marking a universe row an exception for tolerance.

unit.description: Unit counted by stem scorers; split, size and evidence default to distinct stem forms.

members.description: Row ids that are the deviants of split and size, or the grouping of evidence.

context.description: ANDed selectors naming the context size weighs.

evidence.description: Return the one-screen evidence composite for the grouping that where or members names, over stems or forms.

as_of.description: Read the forms source from the Baseline (baseline) or a Proposal's Trial copy (a Proposal id) instead of the latest Trial's evidence; rows carry parse state and analyses, and a Proposal with no completed Trial returns a pending side.

sides.description: both returns the Baseline and the Proposal named by as_of side by side.

sort.description: Order of an as_of run's rows: [baseline.|proposal.]column[:desc], with column form, base, kind, entry, id, morph-type, variant-type, environments, category, tokens, parse-state or parse-tokens.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
